hero.subtitle: Every delivery starts with the right question.
hero.description: The brief opens the conversation. The scope comes after I understand the problem.

productDesign.title: Product Design
productDesign.description: I start with the problem and only then open Figma. I design flows, prototype what needs testing and explain every decision.

frontEnd.title: Front-End
frontEnd.description: What I design, I know how to build. I use React and Tailwind CSS and take each component to deploy, with AI support and review.

designSystems.title: Design Systems
designSystems.description: I organize tokens, components and patterns so the product keeps moving in the same direction, even as the team grows.

process.title: Six steps. From the problem to the next cycle.

understand.title: Understand
understand.subtitle: Research
understand.description: Before opening Figma, I understand the context: who it is for, why it exists and how it will be built.

define.title: Define
define.subtitle: Scope
define.description: I make the problem clear before the solution. I define scope, success criteria and what stays for later.

design.title: Design
design.subtitle: Prototype
design.description: Flow first, then visuals. Experience decisions come before aesthetic ones. The beautiful screen is a consequence.

build.title: Build
build.subtitle: MVP
build.description: Prototype or code, depending on what the problem needs. I can deliver both. I use AI to move faster and review everything it writes.

validate.title: Validate
validate.subtitle: Testing
validate.description: I test with the people who will use it and check that what was designed goes live and works. I adjust before calling it done.

evolve.title: Evolve
evolve.subtitle: Roadmap
evolve.description: A launched product is a product that begins. What the data shows guides the next cycle.

github.title: Design becomes real code.
github.imageAlt: GitHub screen with design and front-end projects
github.text: On my GitHub you will find real applications, experiments, components and products I built from design to deploy.
